Setting up

What do I need?
An iPhone, a projector connected with a USB-C to HDMI adapter, and a tripod that holds both pointed at a wall. Without a projector, games play on the phone screen by touch, and you can still build games.
The app can’t find the projected area.
Playfield calibrates by projecting markers. Keep the whole picture on a flat, plain wall, make sure the phone’s camera sees all of it, and avoid bright light falling straight on the wall. Then choose Recalibrate. Recalibrate again whenever you move the tripod.
Where is the camera permission?
iPhone Settings › Playfield › Camera. The camera is needed to see hands; it is processed on the phone.

Playing

Do I need an account to play?
No. Every game plays without signing in, and playing sends nothing off your phone. An account is only for the game builder.
My hands aren’t picked up.
Hands are easiest to see in a lit room with the projection landing on them. Stand so your hands are between the projector and the wall, not behind your body, and keep sleeves above the wrist. If nobody’s hands are seen for a while, the game pauses on purpose.
Taps land in the wrong place.
The setup has probably moved since calibration. Choose Recalibrate.

The game builder

How does it work?
Open Create, sign in with Apple, then talk or type what you want to play. The builder is an AI model that writes the game, plays it to check it, and changes it when you ask. It needs a connection, your sign-in and your permission.
It asks me to “allow” it. What does that mean?
Before the first request, Playfield shows what the builder sends and who receives it. See the privacy policy.
The builder won’t do my request, or the age check blocks me.
Requests go through a safety filter; rephrase and try again. The builder is for people 13 and older. You can run the age check again in Settings › Safety.
I get an error about providers.
Try again in a moment, or pick another quality in Settings › Builder config.
It’s slow or stops replying.
The panel shows how long it has waited for the model. If it stays quiet for over a minute, tap Stop and send your message again. Very long chats get slower: use Reset chat, and the builder carries on from the game’s notes.
Is the game I made private?
Yes. Games are stored on your phone and are not shared with anyone. The builder sees them only while you are building.

Account and credits

How do I sign in?
With Sign in with Apple, from the builder’s sign-in card or Settings › Account. If it fails, check your connection and that you are signed in to iCloud, then try again.
What are credits?
Each account has a monthly builder allowance that resets each month. Settings › Credits shows what you have used. When it runs out, the builder waits for the reset; your games keep playing. Need more? Email me.
How do I sign out or delete my account?
Settings › Account › Sign out or Delete account. Your games stay on your phone. To also delete usage records and reports linked to your account, email me.

Privacy controls

In Settings › Privacy you can stop the builder sending requests to AI providers, block its camera access, and see what it sends. Details are in the privacy policy.

Report a problem or content

If the builder makes something offensive or harmful, tap the flag on its message or picture, or on the game’s tile on the home screen, and choose a reason. I review every report. You can also email abdulrreshamwala@gmail.com about this or anything else not working, with what you asked for, what happened and a screenshot if you can. Delete a game from the home screen to remove it from your phone. I read every report and reply as soon as I can.

Please include your iPhone model, iOS version and the Playfield version (Settings › About).
